E41_sourcingConditions.conditions: static field (a4' = 0): m S = -36 H^2/kappa and lambda S^2 = 30 H^2/kappa on <S_p> (proper-volume average); together lambda S/m = -5/6 and m S < 0

emt.mismatch: the proper-volume average of the KS energy density is positive while the static field requires rho_req = -21 H^2/kappa < 0 (p_req = +15 H^2/kappa, w_req = -5/7): this KS state alone cannot be the source for kappa > 0.  This is a statement about the positive-energy KS ground state only (STAGE4_SPEC E4.1: the homogeneous m S < 0 condensate can source the field; see E41_sourcingConditions)

thermo.C_V_definition: fixed-spectrum derivative C_V^(0) (T > 0.3 m: no finite difference, as the Rust crate; exact for lambda = 0)

couplingHot.rule: lambda_hat_hot = 0.1 / strength_free(T = m), strength = max_y max((15/16)|S_p|, n_p/16)/m^7 of the free state at T = m (m1_L3_N112_lam0_T1)
couplingHot.note: the Rust value (its own free state at T = m, on its f_cut window, shell cap and node set) is adopted when present so that both sides solve the same Hamiltonian; the reference's own value (maximum over its coarse nodes) is recorded
